data.name: Burial at Sea
data.description:
Honor your loved one with a peaceful burial at sea aboard our Beneteau 40, departing from Mission Bay. Enjoy a serene journey into the Pacific Ocean, where you can scatter ashes in a respectful and intimate environment.
The boat offers a comfortable, private setting, with stunning views of the coastline and the calming sounds of the ocean. Whether for a small family gathering or a more personal moment, we’re here to help you create a memorable and respectful farewell.

As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
